summary: The web app checks its own sign-in at start, and the support link reports which release its documentation describes.

fixes.title: The sign-in check proves itself at start
fixes.text: At start, the web app runs the same check a sign-in takes, with Microsoft's library, on made-up input. If that fails, it does not start, so a problem shows right after an update, not at someone's first sign-in.

fixes.title: The documentation's release is reported
fixes.text: The regular report to Invardia support now names the release the shipped documentation describes, so out-of-date documentation is noticed automatically.
